title: Non-atomic write in set_blocked loses contact changes
description: set_blocked in ContactStore runs 'UPDATE contacts SET blocked = ?' outside any transaction and commits it, then opens a second transaction to advance the state counter and write changed_at_counter. A crash between the two leaves blocked updated but changed_at_counter stale. The contact then never appears in ChatContact/changes until next modification. Same structural defect as update_last_message_at. Fix: wrap both writes in a single transaction.
